nodes.description: Public totalSupply state variable declared in Token and initialized in BRKTToken to 300000000*10**decimals.
Internal mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the constructor.
Internal nested mapping _allowed[owner][spender] holding allowances; used by transferFrom, approve and allowance.
Public string name = "BERKSHIRE TOKEN" set on BRKTToken.
Public uint8 decimals = 6, used to scale the initial totalSupply.
Public string symbol = " BRKT" set on BRKTToken.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes a*b and asserts a==0 || c/a==b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b): asserts b>0 and a==b*c+a%b, returns a/b.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint256 a, uint256 b): asserts b<=a and returns a-b.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes a+b and asserts c>=a && c>=b.
StandardToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): validates _to!=0, balance and overflow, then debits msg.sender and credits _to via SafeMath.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): checks balance and allowance, credits _to, debits _from and decrements allowance.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) view returns the _balances[_owner] value.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): requires zero allowance before overwrite and sets _allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view returns _allowed[_owner][_spender].
BRKTToken payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
BRKTToken constructor: reads totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to _balances[msg.sender], emitting Transfer(0, msg.sender, totalSupply).
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used for balance indexing, allowance spender key, approve key and initial supply minting.
Arithmetic operation uint256 c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded only by an assert-based overflow check (arithmetic risk).
Arithmetic operation uint256 c = a / b inside safeDiv (division, guarded by assert(b>0)).
Arithmetic operation a - b inside safeSub, guarded by assert(b <= a).
Arithmetic operation a + b (and related c>=a && c>=b checks) inside safeAdd.
Overflow guard expression _balances[_to] + _value > _balances[_to] in transfer, vulnerable to unchecked-addition bypass semantics.
Overflow guard expression _balances[_to] + _value > _balances[_to] in transferFrom.
Supply computation 300000000*10**uint256(decimals) expanding the constant into a uint256 total supply (arithmetic/exponentiation).
First uint256 operand parameter a shared by SafeMath.safeMul, safeDiv, safeSub and safeAdd.
Second uint256 operand parameter b shared by SafeMath.safeMul, safeDiv, safeSub and safeAdd.
Parameter _to (recipient address) of StandardToken.transfer.
Parameter _value (amount) of StandardToken.transfer.
Parameter _from (debited owner address) of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _to (credited recipient address) of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _value (amount) of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve.
Parameter _value (allowance amount) of StandardToken.approve.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.balanceOf.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance.
Local variable c = a * b inside SafeMath.safeMul holding the multiplication result.
Local variable c = a / b inside SafeMath.safeDiv holding the division result.
Local variable c = a + b inside SafeMath.safeAdd holding the addition result.
Named return variable balance of StandardToken.balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of StandardToken.allowance.

edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender to read and debit _balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in _allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
constructor mints the whole totalSupply to msg.sender.
Any caller (msg.sender) reaching the payable fallback triggers the revert path.
safeMul contains the unchecked-by-the-compiler multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv contains the division c = a / b whose correctness relies on asserts.
safeSub contains the subtraction a - b.
safeAdd contains the addition a + b and its overflow assertions.
transfer evaluates the addition _balances[_to] + _value as an overflow guard.
transferFrom evaluates the addition _balances[_to] + _value as an overflow guard.
constructor computes totalSupply via 300000000*10**uint256(decimals).
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit _from and the allowance.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.safeMul as the left operand.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.safeMul as the right operand.
Parameter _to of transfer is used as the credit target and zero-address check.
Parameter _value of transfer is the amount moved between balances.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is the debited owner address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is the credited recipient address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is the transferred amount.
Parameter _spender of approve becomes the allowance mapping key.
Parameter _value of approve is stored as the new allowance.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf indexes the _balances mapping.
Parameter _owner of allowance indexes _allowed.
Parameter _spender of allowance indexes _allowed.
Local variable c in safeMul receives the a*b result within the function.
Local variable c in safeDiv receives the a/b result within the function.
Local variable c in safeAdd receives the a+b result within the function.
Return variable balance is assigned from _balances[_owner] inside balanceOf.
Return variable remaining is assigned from _allowed[_owner][_spender] inside allowance.
